messages:
deploy-bot: release 2026-03-15-1420 deployed to prod (canary passed). tagging rollout-id=rl-20260315-1420

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency threshold breached for /v1/generate (p99=4.8s, p95=1.1s) — alert fired at 2245009880. Error rate rising (5xx ~2.3%). Pager sent to #incidents and on-call.

sam: taking this pager now. started digging into canary vs prod diffs. any recent config toggles?

ingrid: I merged the kv-cache affinity change in that release (PR #4123). It should be a no-op for smaller payloads but maybe affects long requests. rolling back?

raj: seeing timeouts from runtime gateways -> `upstream_timeout` in the logs. stack traces show requests waiting on grpc calls to model-hosts.

sam: pulling logs for gateway-01,02. grep shows an increase in `rpc_wait_ms` spikes right after rollout. past deploy window correlates ~1m after rollout.

alice: support pinged — a handful of customers reported requests hanging, mainly higher token-length requests (>=800 tokens).

maria: are we seeing customer-impacted percent? need to know for comms.

sam: quick estimate — 0.6% of requests, but those are 20% of token volume. could be larger for a few heavy customers. tagging ops for priority.

oncall-ops: please confirm if SLA is violated. Current SLO: 99.9% under 3s p99. We're outside that window. Recommend mitigation: revert rollout to previous model-routing and evict new kv affinity.

ingrid: I can revert the kv-cache affinity change. rollback on the service side would be faster though. which rollback path is safest?

sam: two options: 1) config rollback of kv-affinity (safer, limited blast radius) 2) full release rollback to previous image. I prefer option 1 first to validate. executing a rollback of the affinity flag now.

raj: if you flip that flag, watch for cache misses — might temporarily spike serving cost but reduces latency.

ingrid: flipping `kv_affinity.enabled=false` in prod config now...

[code block]
ingrid: ```
kubectl patch configmap inference-config -n redwood --patch '{"data":{"kv_affinity":"false"}}'
```

sam: monitoring metrics... p99 dropping from 4.8s -> 1.4s within 60s. error rate down to 0.8%. good sign.

incident-bot: Note: autopaging suppressed while mitigation ongoing.

maria: good — please hold on customer comms until we confirm stable. question: do we still need a full rollback?

sam: let's observe 10m window. if p99 remains <1.2s and errors <0.5% we can avoid full rollback. otherwise roll back release.

alice: I notified top-5 impacted customers: they acknowledged and asked for ETA. I'll update depending on outcome.

raj: also see some saturated recv queues on model-hosts with long prefix KV fetches. affinity change likely increased KV cache misses for long sequences.

ingrid: opening hotfix PR to revert the affinity code path in next release to prevent recurrence.

sam: 10m check — p99 0.98s, p95 0.9s, 5xx 0.3%. holding. moving to monitoring -> status stable.

maria: thanks. do we want a follow-up postmortem and customer note? Recommend short incident report and signal to account team.

sam: I'll own initial incident report and run small regression test suite for long-token workloads on canary next time.

alice: will draft the customer-facing note and coordinate with sales.

ingrid: PR created: revert-kv-affinity (link to PR). scheduling patch release after tests.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to 'resolved' at 2245010400 by sam. Postmortem requested.

sam: handing off to post-incident owner for writeup and RCA. closing thread once report is attached. :white_check_mark:
